Causal-review instructions still described spawning a subagent as the only execution contract even after the shared default moved to file-backed codex exec/claude -p workers. The issue skill and causal-review reference now describe the adapter-selected worker as default, typed subagents as explicit optional branches, and require typed receipt/report delivery with no same-agent substitute.

The file-backed carrier initially joined receipt/output hashes and packet/input identities but did not consume the canonical bounded-review result schema or require verdict pass. A forged minimal or block result could therefore look approval-eligible. The shared result contract is now validated by the runner, report consumer, and issue carrier, with regression coverage.

The issue carrier initially inspected only the final ledger state and findings hash, so a forged or impossible history could rejoin a valid-looking report. It now uses the canonical DeliveryAttempt.from_dict history/transition validator, with a forged-history regression.

The file-backed runner initially resolved prompt, schema, output, receipt, ledger, and report paths from launch cwd rather than the explicit repository root. Relative paths now anchor to --repo-root and outside-root paths refuse, with an unrelated-cwd regression.

The explicit accepted-unreviewed-under-round-cap state was checked after delegated-token containment, so its explanatory text could be misclassified as completed delegation. Round-cap detection now precedes delegated matching and the issue consumer refuses it as non-approval.

The Markdown readers stripped fenced code but still treated four-space indented CommonMark code as live artifact text. A quoted reviewer claim could therefore satisfy the fresh-eye field. Shared issue Markdown readers now drop indented code blocks, with regressions for both the stripper and observer.

Grandfathering checked old commit age but initially did not require current bytes to equal the old committed artifact. A tracked artifact modified today could self-attest an old date and bypass the typed contract. Production comparison now requires the current candidate to equal git show HEAD, with a regression.

Reviewed-input identity followed symlink text inconsistently: it resolved the parent for containment but hashed the link itself. The identity builder now refuses symlinked reviewed paths and requires an explicit target path, with a regression replacing the former retargeting behavior.

The packet consumer checked prepared_for issue text but not the packet's repository field, allowing a self-consistent foreign repository field to rejoin the current issue number. Carrier validation now binds repo and issue, with a foreign packet-repo regression.

The carrier initially joined ledger attempt identity through nested provenance but did not compare the report's top-level attempt_id. It now requires report, provenance, receipt, and canonical ledger attempt identifiers to agree, with a regression.

Close consumers initially treated a missing repository or non-integer number in live readback as harmless silence and had no strict pre-mutation target readback. A shared issue identity validator now requires exact repo and integer number before comment/close and after close, and verify-closeout uses the same rule.

A focused identity test was first invoked through the guessed tests/quality_gates/test_reviewed_input_identity.py path, which does not exist. The repository inventory showed the actual tests/test_reviewed_input_identity_binding.py and tests/test_reviewed_input_identity_failures.py surfaces; the correct paths were then run.

A shell heredoc command was malformed by appending a shell conjunction inside the Python heredoc, producing a SyntaxError before the intended inventory command ran. The command was split into separate tool actions; no repository file was changed by the failed invocation.

One orchestration tool call used malformed JavaScript object syntax for max_output_tokens and failed before executing a command. The call was retried with a valid object shape; no repository state changed.

Installed retro planner emitted a repo-relative command that the consumer resolved against the wrong cwd/skill root. The planner now carries an absolute owning script path and installed-layout regression coverage in tests/quality_gates/test_retro_installed_plan_path.py.

Exact-base changed-line proof blocked after standing pytest passed because eight verdict-surface files had uncovered refusal/import branches. Direct counterexamples now own the dynamic loader, identity, pre-mutation readback, Markdown, typed delegation, and observer paths; the same committed base must be rerun before claiming clean proof.
Transport failure was mislabeled as credential invalid because filesystem, external-read, and external-effect authority were collapsed; converted into an explicit capability-envelope contract.

Two external Luna workers selected installed Charness 6.4.0 impl policy after #713 repaired current source/plugin policy, then stopped on an unrelated pathless risk interrupt. Exact-path requalification changed the observer input but did not prove installed adoption; #715 now owns explicit version selection and installed readback.

Ceal lane scope preflight parsed multiline human-readable grep output as a path record. Narrowing tokens avoided the record but was not recovery; Ceal #733 owns record-safe framing, typed malformed-record refusal, and the CLI regression.

Ceal's canonical worktree launcher created dependency/build symlink entries that trailing-slash ignore patterns exposed as untracked files. Ceal #734 joins launcher and ignore policy with a post-wire porcelain readback.

Parallel external workers opened independent durable lesson sessions and modified tracked ledger/receipts outside task paths. #716 owns parent-session inheritance or explicit worker read-only/lane-local session behavior instead of integration-time discards or merges.

Installed version, unframed record, generated worktree artifact, and lesson-session ownership failures share a missing producer-to-consumer identity join. The debug artifact binds the pattern and Charness #715/#716 plus Ceal #733/#734 own the structural repairs.
Round-2 review found substantive duplicate H2s passed pursue readiness while full validation refused them; readiness now consumes canonical duplicate facts with typed blockers.
TAP markers and duration fragments were treated as run ownership; compact, inner-header, and incomplete-summary falsifiers are now durable reporter/classifier regressions.

Focused tests proved TAP semantics but did not declare the new skipped-state consumer; pre-commit caught it and the source/plugin visibility contract now records the terminal evidence boundary.

Substring-based optional nonclaims accepted contradictory prose; target-bound structured records and exact collective digests now join envelope, result, receipt, report, and carrier.

Worker reported pre-commit completed but also disclosed the tree was unstaged, so zero checks executed; independent Ruff exposed two C901 failures. Process and policy ownership were split, Ruff now passes, and the implementation artifact records the proof gap.

Manual Ruff covered the newly refactored files but omitted another changed runner; the actual staged pre-commit found import-order drift in both source and mirror. Direct imports repaired; closeout relies on the full staged path set, not a hand-selected subset.

Standing 11,343 passed, but exact base-to-HEAD coverage blocked seven changed parser branches. Semantic regressions now own earlier-duration termination, duplicate/negative/count-total refusal, plan-first compact ownership, and summary present/absent outcomes.
